title: The server's side of enrolling through its identity provider
spec: ExternalSignIn keys its pending nonces by device or by an invitation's bootstrap key; the two never satisfy each other. begin_enrollment(bootstrap key) and verify_enrollment(bootstrap key, code, verifier, redirect) use a nonce once within PENDING_MS and apply the sign-in checks (loopback redirect, code exchange, ID token with that nonce and require-mfa, one key refresh), and with an authorizer require a fresh allow with use, storing nothing. ExternalSignIn implements crewcraft_bootstrap::ExternalEnrollment over them (begin draws fresh random bytes). bootstrap_handler_with(.., Some(provider)) makes the bootstrap connection enroll through it, and LabRuntime::with_external passes the provider there as well as to device sign-in.
